metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: A high-energy workplace sitcom with a wholesome heart similar to Ted Lasso and Community.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: An ensemble-led police comedy that captures the same fast-paced, uplifting vibe as New Girl and Scrubs.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: Classic British awkward humor that matches the energy of Peep Show and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A warm, character-driven animation that serves as a perfect comfort show for fans of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Smart, layered comedy with a high density of jokes similar to Community and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult British comedy directed by Edgar Wright that blends pop-culture references and surrealism like Community.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A cynical yet hilarious British sitcom featuring a misanthropic bookstore owner, perfect for Peep Show fans.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A mockumentary about vampires that balances supernatural elements with mundane office-style comedy similar to It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A hilarious and lighthearted British reality competition that features many comedians you likely enjoy from other UK shows.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: Fast-talking, witty adult animation with a spy twist that appeals to fans of Rick and Morty and Futurama.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A wholesome, character-focused comedy that starts out cynical and evolves into a feel-good story like Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the co-creators of Rick and Morty, offering the same sci-fi absurdity and sharp humor.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi adventure that balances comedy with a genuine love for space exploration, reminiscent of Futurama and Doctor Who.

metas.name: Firefly
metas.description: A fun action-adventure in space with a strong ensemble cast, fitting the vibe of Fallout and ONE PIECE.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: An intelligent adult animation that parodies pop culture and superheroes, perfect for One-Punch Man and Rick and Morty fans.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: The ultimate comfort background show with a mix of cringe humor and heartfelt moments similar to Scrubs.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Fast-paced, satirical, and full of weird characters, matching the high-concept energy of Community.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A sharp-tongued political comedy with high-quality writing similar to Silicon Valley and The Good Place.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A lighthearted and charming British sitcom about a group of spirits living in an old house.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern mockumentary sitcom that provides easy-to-watch, uplifting laughs in a school setting.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The peak of 'comfort' television—wholesome, relaxing, and very easy to watch in the background.

metas.name: Final Space
metas.description: An animated space adventure that mixes emotional stakes with quirky comedy like Futurama.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, this series offers incredible action with a heartwarming, lighthearted story.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A delightful action-comedy anime about a fake family that is both hilarious and incredibly feel-good.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A lighthearted pirate adventure comedy that emphasizes character growth and found family like Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: The spiritual cousin to It's Always Sunny and Peep Show, focusing on social faux pas and hilarious escalations.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: A standard-bearer for easy-to-watch family sitcoms that provides consistent laughs and comfort.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a video game studio, created by the team behind It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: A unique and awkward British comedy featuring Jamie Demetriou that fans of Brassic and Peep Show will love.

metas.name: Friday Night Dinner
metas.description: A hilarious British family sitcom focusing on the eccentricities of home life, matching the humor of The Simpsons.

metas.name: Red Dwarf
metas.description: A classic British sci-fi sitcom that combines the 'losers in space' vibe of Futurama with UK comedy sensibilities.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A sweet and funny sitcom about a family running a grocery store, perfect for a relaxing evening.

metas.name: Letterkenny
metas.description: Fast-paced, wordplay-heavy Canadian comedy that matches the sharp dialogue seen in It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A riotous and nostalgic British/Irish sitcom about teenagers that is both hilarious and heartwarming.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A dry, musical comedy series from New Zealand that captures the quirky spirit of Master of None.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A brilliant but short-lived corporate satire that hits the same notes as Silicon Valley and Mythic Quest.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult classic ensemble comedy about caterers that fits the vibe of It's Always Sunny and Community.

metas.name: The Dragon Prince
metas.description: An uplifting fantasy adventure with great world-building, ideal for fans of ONE PIECE and Doctor Who.

metas.name: The Tick
metas.description: A comedic take on the superhero genre that is much lighter and more whimsical than modern caped-crusader shows.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A surreal and hilarious comedy about two friends in NYC that shares the chaotic energy of New Girl and It's Always Sunny.
